Shillong Teer Results Today, July 10, 2025: Winning Numbers For All Teer Games
Shillong Teer Result Today LIVE UPDATES. Here's full list of common and winning numbers for Shillong Teer, Juwai Teer, Khanapara Teer, and more for July 10, 2025 below.
Shillong Teer is a legal archery-based lottery played in Meghalaya. (Image: Shutterstock)
Shillong Teer is a legal archery-based lottery played in Meghalaya. (Image: Shutterstock)
SHILLONG TEER RESULT TODAY, JULY 10, 2025 LIVE UPDATES: The Shillong Teer lottery game is a popular archery-based game played daily at the Shillong Polo Stadium. The Khasi Hills Archery Sports Association hosts the game. This lottery not only gives a chance to win a huge sum of money but also encourages the young generation to play archery.

These teer games initiated by the Khasi Hills Archery Sports Association gained a lot of popularity among the youth. The results can be found on the Khasi Hills Archery Sports Association (KHASA) website and at meghalayateer.com.
HOW TO PLAY SHILLONG LOTTERY?
- There will be two rounds for two minutes.
- In the first round, archers shoot 30 arrows, and in the second round, they shoot 20 arrows.
- Participants can place their bets by choosing a number between 0 and 99.
- They have to predict how many arrows will hit the target.
- Tickets are available at licensed counters and range from Rs 1 to Rs 50.
- 30 arrows an archer can shoot in the first round, and in the second round, it will be 20.
- You must place a bet on a number between 0 and 99.
Tickets of Rs. 1, Rs. 5, Rs. 10, Rs. 20 and Rs. 50 are available at the licensed counters.
Participants who accurately predict the outcome of either round in the Shillong Teer lottery stand a chance to win cash prizes. The payout depends on both the wagered amount and the accuracy of the prediction. For instance, a correct prediction in the first round on a ₹1 bet can earn ₹80, while the same bet in the second round yields ₹60. If a participant bets ₹1 on both rounds and correctly predicts both outcomes, the winnings can go up to ₹4,000.
